messages:
Alex (Sales): FYI — AcmeFin POC kickoff tomorrow. They want BYO HSM + automatic failover. Need clarity on: 1) added latency during HSM failover, 2) billing for egress to customer's HSM, 3) rotation strategies with zero-downtime, 4) POC pricing/credits. Can SRE/security/pricing weigh in?
Sam (Security): We support BYO keys via a proxy that forwards ops to the customer HSM. Key question: do they need in-HSM signing ops or only key wrapping? If signing, attestation & FIPS level required. Also ask custodian policy (# of custodians) for rotation playbook.
Jordan (SRE): Ops note: fallback to a Redwood-managed variant typically adds ~150–450ms p99 depending on inter-region RTT and KV cache coldness. With persistent KV cache + warm connections, p99 can be ~120–200ms. Test plan: 100 RPS burst, 80-token responses, simulate HSM tail latency and compare cold vs warmed prefix cache.
Leah (Solutions): I'll prep the POC checklist. Need sample API call and throughput targets, plus whether they expect in-HSM crypto. Also request attestation artifacts (certs). We'll propose a canary cutover (5% -> 25% -> 100%).
Alex (Sales): Example BYO call they used — customer will supply credentials:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-CMK-IDENTIFIER: projects/acme/keys/customer-hsm-1" \
  -d '{"prompt":"foo","max_tokens":64}'
```
Jordan (SRE): Add an internal test header to toggle failover: X-Redwood-Force-Failover: true. Capture per-request timing in traces (token-level).
Priya (Pricing): Pricing note: BYO-HSM proxy = $1,200/mo base + ~$0.30 per 1k HSM egress ops during POC (we can credit month one). SLA for failover <500ms is a premium add-on. I'll DM a formal quote.
Rosa (Legal): If they request BYO keys, confirm whether they want key escrow. If yes, we need escrow clauses and confirmation we're not holding plaintext keys. Also confirm audit-log exportability and retention (fintech often asks 7 yrs).
Jordan (SRE): Rotation suggestion to avoid downtime: stage new key in HSM, configure proxy to accept new identifier as secondary, atomically swap routing pointer, ramp traffic, then retire old key after TTL. Rough rollout API example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.internal/rollout -d '{"route":"cmk-proxy","weights":{"primary":0.0,"secondary":1.0}}'
```
Leah (Solutions): I'll own the runbook+timeline: Wed internal dry run, Thu customer session (30m), Fri validation. Will include SRE test vectors and security checklist. Priya, can you join Thu for pricing brief?
Priya (Pricing): Yep. I'll prepare a short POC pricing sheet for reserved vs metered scenarios.
Sam (Security): I'll review attestation docs after Leah shares the runbook. Also confirm whether rotation will be triggered by Redwood or their custodian — affects audit events.
Alex (Sales): They want rotation triggered from their Key Management UI (custodian-initiated). Leah, please ensure runbook supports external rotation triggers and we log the event with timestamps.
Leah (Solutions): Noted. I'll add a 'custodian-initiated rotation' section with expected API events and log format; draft by EOD.
Alex (Sales): If quoting + runbook by EOD I can lock Wed/Thu with customer. Thanks all :thumbsup: 
Sam (Security): +1 — standing by to sign off once attestation PDF is uploaded.
Rosa (Legal): Flagged potential escrow language; will follow up after runbook.
